summary: Georgia list places a Hazzards Neck lookout tower in Camden County (GFC 842); OpenStreetMap tags it an observation tower; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: No source we checked says whether the tower still stands

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out against the list (Camden County, GFC 842, elevation 30 on the list matches the 9.1 m record); no corrections. Two WebSearch queries returned nothing about this tower (one hit Harris Neck in McIntosh County, a different place). The Forest Lookouts site has no Hazzards Neck page (404). The OpenStreetMap elevation tag is 9 m. The USGS GNIS page for feature 344252 loaded without naming this feature in readable text. No built date, staffing, or fate is documented, so the story runs only on the register entry and the map tag. Worth a human look: a local Camden County historical source could change this story.
